localizedDescriptions.en: Inspect design context from Figma Desktop on the same computer.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 读取同一台电脑上 Figma Desktop 的设计信息。

en: Summarize the selected frame and list its main components and layout rules.
zh-CN: 概述当前选中的画框，列出其中的主要组件和布局规则。

instructions.en: Sign in to Figma Desktop on the same computer as NeuxBot Core. Open a Figma Design file, switch to Dev Mode and enable the desktop MCP server in the right sidebar. A Dev or Full seat on an eligible Figma plan is required.
instructions.zh-CN: 在运行 NeuxBot Core 的同一台电脑上登录 Figma Desktop。打开 Figma Design 文件，切换到 Dev Mode，在右侧栏启用桌面 MCP 服务。此功能需要符合条件的 Figma 套餐及 Dev 或 Full 席位。
